tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search EventCompletion's curated events by words in the name or description (every word must match, any order), optionally filtered by status, category and language. Returns dates, progress, location and the page URL.

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Events that start soonest (curated catalogue). Use it for "what is coming up?" questions.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Details of one event by slug (the last part of its URL), including progress right now and where its dates were verified.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Issue an API key for your agent (shown once, keep it). Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" on later requests for higher rate limits. Give a contact_email to be able to create events: a confirmation link is sent to it.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a public progress page for an event (needs an API key whose contact e-mail is confirmed; max 10 per day). The event is unlisted: it is reachable by its URL but not featured in the catalogue or sitemap. Dates are inclusive calendar days.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_events, get_event · Private data: register_agent, create_event · Public sink: register_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_events, get_event · Private data: register_agent, create_event · Public sink: register_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
